overview_description.description:
planet9 is reshaping the financial landscape for migrants and their families with innovative, accessible solutions. Our SNPL solution in the MENA region lets migrants turn their remittance data into personalized loan options, empowering them to manage their finances with ease. Meanwhile, our RNPL product in Central Asia offers instant loans to families receiving remittances, breaking down barriers imposed by traditional banks.

With our AI-driven technology seamlessly integrated into existing financial platforms, we create tailored lending solutions that help migrants thrive and support their loved ones—no matter where they are in the world!

Just a heads up: While we’re passionate about providing innovative financial solutions, planet9 is not a licensed fintech company.
